definitions.brier_score: Mean squared error between the frozen probability and binary outcome; lower is better.
definitions.log_loss: Mean negative log likelihood using the policy probability clamp; lower is better.
definitions.expected_calibration_error: Absolute forecast-versus-outcome gap weighted across 10 equal-width probability bins.
definitions.model_to_close_probability_delta: same-side closing probability minus frozen model probability
definitions.private_clv: same-side closing probability minus average entry price
